rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Shinn...
rows.display_text: 「Shinn...」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Focus, Shinn. What's coming now is the Chairman's... the world's enemy.
rows.display_text:
「Focus, Shinn. What's coming now is the
Chairman's... the world's enemy.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Rey...

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: No matter what happens from here on... no matter what anyone says, believe in the Chairman.
rows.display_text:
「No matter what happens from here on...
no matter what anyone says, believe in
the Chairman.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: The world is going to change. We're the ones who'll change it.
rows.display_text:
「The world is going to change. We're the
ones who'll change it.」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: But at times like that, in the middle of the chaos, there may be moments you have to make choices unlike any before.
rows.display_text:
「But at times like that, in the middle of
the chaos, there may be moments you
have to make choices unlike any before.」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: There may be times you don't understand anything and just want to run.
rows.display_text:
「There may be times you don't
understand anything and just want to run.」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: But as long as you believe in the Chairman, it'll be all right.
rows.display_text:
「But as long as you believe in the
Chairman, it'll be all right.」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Because he's the one who's right.
rows.display_text: 「Because he's the one who's right.」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: ...Here they come.
rows.display_text: 「...Here they come.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: The Archangel...! And the Eternal!
rows.display_text: 「The Archangel...! And the Eternal!」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: To think they'd come straight at us with that much force...!
rows.display_text:
「To think they'd come straight at us
with that much force...!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: (Kira Yamato...)
rows.display_text: （(Kira Yamato...)）

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: This is the Eternal, Lacus Clyne speaking.
rows.display_text:
「This is the Eternal, Lacus Clyne
speaking.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: This is a notice to the ZAFT soldiers guarding Messiah.
rows.display_text:
「This is a notice to the ZAFT soldiers
guarding Messiah.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: We are about to begin our operation to stop the Destiny Plan.
rows.display_text:
「We are about to begin our operation to
stop the Destiny Plan.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: If you still carry any pride in wearing that uniform for the sake of peace, then clear the way!
rows.display_text:
「If you still carry any pride in wearing
that uniform for the sake of peace, then
clear the way!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Lacus Clyne...!
rows.display_text: 「Lacus Clyne...!」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: All units, can you hear me! Our objective is to whittle down the enemy's forces.
rows.display_text:
「All units, can you hear me! Our
objective is to whittle down the enemy's
forces.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: Operation time is four minutes. If we shoot down 150 enemy units within that time, the operation's a success.
rows.display_text:
「Operation time is four minutes. If we
shoot down 150 enemy units within that
time, the operation's a success.」

rows.speaker: Mu
rows.en: Rough, this one. Even I, who's seen hell, feel a little sick just thinking about it.
rows.display_text:
「Rough, this one. Even I, who's seen
hell, feel a little sick just thinking about
it.」

rows.speaker: Murrue
rows.en: Mu...

rows.speaker: Mu
rows.en: Don't worry, Murrue. I'm a man who makes the impossible possible. I'll come back alive, guaranteed.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry, Murrue. I'm a man who
makes the impossible possible. I'll come
back alive, guaranteed.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Let's go, Athrun. For the sake of our future.
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, Athrun. For the sake of our
future.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Right...!
rows.display_text: 「Right...!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Athrun...!
rows.display_text: 「Athrun...!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: I won't hesitate anymore! Here I come, Shinn!!
rows.display_text:
「I won't hesitate anymore! Here I come,
Shinn!!」

rows.speaker: Chandra
rows.en: Four minutes of operation time have passed!
rows.display_text:
「Four minutes of operation time have
passed!」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Enemy kills: {tm}! We've reached the target!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy kills: {tm}! We've reached the
target!」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: All right! The operation's a success! We're charging into the fortress together with the Murasame squad!
rows.display_text:
「All right! The operation's a success!
We're charging into the fortress together
with the Murasame squad!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: (Chairman Durandal... we won't accept the world you want.)
rows.display_text:
（(Chairman Durandal... we won't accept
the world you want.)）

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: (I will stop you and the Destiny Plan, without fail.)
rows.display_text:
（(I will stop you and the Destiny Plan,
without fail.)）

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: It's no good! Enemy kills: {tm}! We haven't reached 150!
rows.display_text:
「It's no good! Enemy kills: {tm}! We
haven't reached 150!」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: The operation's failed! All units, withdraw!
rows.display_text:
「The operation's failed! All units,
withdraw!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: At this rate, our world will...
rows.display_text: 「At this rate, our world will...」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: New mobile suit unit approaching! Twenty of them!
rows.display_text:
「New mobile suit unit approaching!
Twenty of them!」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: That fortress still has forces held in reserve! Let's draw them out!
rows.display_text:
「That fortress still has forces held in
reserve! Let's draw them out!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Damn it! Why does it have to be you, of all people!!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! Why does it have to be you,
of all people!!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: You too, enough already! Stop fighting while you're still trapped by the past!
rows.display_text:
「You too, enough already! Stop fighting
while you're still trapped by the past!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Athrun!
rows.display_text: 「Athrun!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Doing that won't bring anything back!
rows.display_text: 「Doing that won't bring anything back!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Wh-what did you say!
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what did you say!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: And yet you're going to kill even the future!? Is that what you want!?
rows.display_text:
「And yet you're going to kill even the
future!? Is that what you want!?」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Is that power really what you wanted!?
rows.display_text: 「Is that power really what you wanted!?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Ngh!
rows.display_text: 「Ngh!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: (Shinn... understand this. Fighting like this will never change anything...)
rows.display_text:
（(Shinn... understand this. Fighting like
this will never change anything...)）

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Ngh!
rows.display_text: 「Ngh!」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Sis, stop it!
rows.display_text: 「Sis, stop it!」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Meyrin!? On the Eternal!?
rows.display_text: 「Meyrin!? On the Eternal!?」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Why are you fighting? Why are you fighting!? Why can't you tell which Lacus is the real one!?
rows.display_text:
「Why are you fighting? Why are you
fighting!? Why can't you tell which Lacus
is the real one!?」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Meyrin...
rows.display_text: 「Meyrin...」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: (Sis... once this fight is over, we can be together again, right...?)
rows.display_text:
（(Sis... once this fight is over, we can
be together again, right...?)）

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Not yet, Kira Yamato! I am... I am!
rows.display_text: 「Not yet, Kira Yamato! I am... I am!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Who are you! Just who are you!?
rows.display_text: 「Who are you! Just who are you!?」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: You should understand, of all people...! I am... Rau Le Creuset!
rows.display_text:
「You should understand, of all people...!
I am... Rau Le Creuset!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: People's dreams, people's futures -- their splendid result, Kira Yamato!
rows.display_text:
「People's dreams, people's futures --
their splendid result, Kira Yamato!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Ngh...

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Then you, too, must disappear -- this time for good!
rows.display_text:
「Then you, too, must disappear -- this
time for good!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Rau Le Creuset...
rows.display_text: 「Rau Le Creuset...」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Together with us! For the sake of a world reborn!
rows.display_text:
「Together with us! For the sake of a
world reborn!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: And that which can never be taken back... is the past!
rows.display_text:
「And that which can never be taken
back... is the past!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: So I'll bring it all to an end -- all of it! And humanity will return to the form it was always meant to have!
rows.display_text:
「So I'll bring it all to an end -- all of
it! And humanity will return to the form
it was always meant to have!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: The world, too!
rows.display_text: 「The world, too!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: But no, that's wrong!
rows.display_text: 「But no, that's wrong!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Ugh...!

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Life... everyone only gets one, no matter who they are!
rows.display_text:
「Life... everyone only gets one, no
matter who they are!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: So that life is yours! It's not his!!
rows.display_text: 「So that life is yours! It's not his!!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Ah... ahh...

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: Aaaaahh!
rows.display_text: 「Aaaaahh!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Rey...

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Your life belongs to you... Please understand that...
rows.display_text:
「Your life belongs to you... Please
understand that...」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: ...I'm sure all of you already understand. The reason war has never vanished from human history since records began...
rows.display_text:
「...I'm sure you all already understand
why war has never vanished from human
history since records began...」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: The enemy that always exists... is our own ignorance and greed, which we have never once been able to overcome.
rows.display_text:
「The enemy that always exists... is our
own ignorance and greed, which we have
never once been able to overcome.」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: Even now, having left the Earth to soar through space, having gained control over our bodies' abilities and so many of their secrets...
rows.display_text:
「Even now -- having left Earth to roam
space, having mastered our bodies and so
many of their secrets...」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: People still don't understand each other, don't know themselves, and live with the anxiety of not seeing tomorrow...
rows.display_text:
「People still don't understand each
other, don't know themselves, and live
with the anxiety of not seeing tomorrow...」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: Reaching out endlessly with insatiable greed for equality -- no, for more, for greater abundance. That is what we are, even now.
rows.display_text:
「Reaching out endlessly, insatiably
greedy for equality -- no, for more, for
abundance. That's what we are, even now.」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: The seed of conflict, the whole problem -- it all lies right there!
rows.display_text:
「The seed of conflict, the whole problem
-- it all lies right there!」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: But the time has come to put an end to that. The time when we finally can.
rows.display_text:
「But the time has come to put an end
to that. The time when we finally can.」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: We have finally obtained the means to overcome all of it.
rows.display_text:
「We have finally obtained the means to
overcome all of it.」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: Everyone already carries every answer within themselves!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone already carries every answer
within themselves!」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: Through this, we come to know others, know ourselves, and know tomorrow...
rows.display_text:
「Through this, we come to know others,
know ourselves, and know tomorrow...」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: This is the only way to stop the tragedy from repeating itself.
rows.display_text:
「This is the only way to stop the
tragedy from repeating itself.」

rows.speaker: Durandal
rows.en: As humanity's last line of defense, wagering our very survival, I hereby declare the implementation of the Destiny Plan!
rows.display_text:
「As our last line of defense, wagering
humanity's survival, I hereby declare the
Destiny Plan's implementation!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: ...Chairman Durandal...
rows.display_text: 「...Chairman Durandal...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: ...There's nothing left but to fight... huh...
rows.display_text:
「...There's nothing left but to fight...
huh...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Kira...
rows.display_text: 「Kira...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Ah... no... I was just thinking, they probably feel the same way over there...
rows.display_text:
「Ah... no... I was just thinking, they
probably feel the same way over there...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Ah...

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: There's no choice but to fight... That this leaves us no choice but to fight.
rows.display_text:
「There's no choice but to fight... That
this leaves us no choice but to fight.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: In the end, we keep on fighting. I hate the Plan too... but really, I just want to put an end to all of this.
rows.display_text:
「In the end, we keep on fighting. I hate
the Plan too... but really, I just want to
put an end to all of this.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: But we too... for now, have no choice but to fight.
rows.display_text:
「But we too... for now, have no choice
but to fight.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Lacus...
rows.display_text: 「Lacus...」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: To dream... to hope for a future... That is a strength given to every life, to help it go on living.
rows.display_text:
「To dream... to hope for a future...
That is a strength given to every life,
to help it go on living.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: No matter what we gain, if our dreams and our future are sealed away, we can only exist as beings already destroyed.
rows.display_text:
「No matter what we gain, if our dreams
and our future are sealed away, we can
only exist as beings already destroyed.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Every life fights in order to gain a future. It has every right to fight.
rows.display_text:
「Every life fights in order to gain a
future. It has every right to fight.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Yeah.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: So we, too, must fight -- as lives living in the present.
rows.display_text:
「So we, too, must fight -- as lives
living in the present.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Against whatever seeks to destroy us... and against the world of death the Chairman would show us.
rows.display_text:
「Against whatever seeks to destroy us...
and against the world of death the
Chairman would show us.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: The Eternal and the Archangel will strike ZAFT's fortress head-on.
rows.display_text:
「The Eternal and the Archangel will
strike ZAFT's fortress head-on.」

rows.speaker: DaCosta
rows.en: You can't be...! Without even the Murasame squad as a diversion?
rows.display_text:
「You can't be...! Without even the
Murasame squad as a diversion?」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: It's the other way around. We're the ones acting as bait for them.
rows.display_text:
「It's the other way around. We're the
ones acting as bait for them.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: So we're the ones drawing off ZAFT's main force?
rows.display_text:
「So we're the ones drawing off ZAFT's
main force?」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: It's not just decoy duty. We whittle down the main force's strength as much as we possibly can.
rows.display_text:
「It's not just decoy duty. We whittle
down the main force's strength as much
as we possibly can.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: Once ZAFT's forces are worn down, the Murasame squad hits them from the flank.
rows.display_text:
「Once ZAFT's forces are worn down, the
Murasame squad hits them from the flank.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: We have to fight... That's why, on that day... we left Orb.
rows.display_text:
「We have to fight... That's why, on that
day... we left Orb.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Kira...
rows.display_text: 「Kira...」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: I too... have made my resolve.
rows.display_text: 「I too... have made my resolve.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: The objective is to shoot down 150 mobile suits within the four-minute operation time.
rows.display_text:
「The objective is to shoot down 150
mobile suits within the four-minute
operation time.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: But be careful. To protect the Chairman, they'll be sending out ace-level pilots too.
rows.display_text:
「But be careful. To protect the
Chairman, they'll be sending out ace-level
pilots too.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: (Ace pilot... ZAFT Red... Shinn... are you coming too...?)
rows.display_text:
（(Ace pilot... ZAFT Red... Shinn... are
you coming too...?)）

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Athrun...?
rows.display_text: 「Athrun...?」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: I'm fine, Kira. I've made my resolve too -- same as you.
rows.display_text:
「I'm fine, Kira. I've made my resolve too
-- same as you.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: (Shinn... if you're going to fight for the Chairman's sake, then I'll fight you.)
rows.display_text:
（(Shinn... if you're going to fight for
the Chairman's sake, then I'll fight you.)）

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: (That's the fight I've chosen.)
rows.display_text: （(That's the fight I've chosen.)）
